title: Host Terms of Service: Appeals, Reinstatement and Account Closure
content:
# Host Terms of Service — Appeals, Reinstatement and Closure (Host Accounts)

**Clause 1 — Right of appeal.** A host may appeal a suspension, a restriction, a strike or a penalty once, through a host appeal, which Roamhaven decides within the decision time of the account's tier.

**Clause 2 — Reinstatement.** A suspended account is reinstated only when its account suspension appeal has been approved. The suspension appeal must have been submitted within the appeal window of the account's tier (30 calendar days after the suspension); the days are counted from the suspended date to the date part of the appeal's submission time, and an appeal on the last day stands.

**Clause 3 — Effect of reinstatement.** Reinstatement restores the account to active, releases the payout holds placed for the suspension, and lets the host reinstate suspended listings under the Listings rules.

**Clause 3A — Retired wording.** The clause that reinstatement "does not restore Superhost status, which returns only through a later met assessment" is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis of Host Accounts.

**Clause 4 — Permanent suspension.** A suspension becomes permanent and the account is deactivated by Roamhaven when the appeal is denied or no appeal was submitted in the window.

**Clause 5 — Closure by the host.** A host may close an active account only when none of its stays is requested, confirmed or checked in.

## Reinstatement conditions together

| Account suspension appeal | Submitted within the window | Reinstated? |
|---|---|---|
| Approved | Yes | Both conditions for reinstatement hold |
| Approved | No | No — the appeal was not submitted within the window |
| Submitted, not yet decided | Yes | No — the appeal has not been approved |
| Denied | Yes or no | No; the suspension becomes permanent |

## Window boundary (hypothetical suspended date 4 April, 30-day window)

| Appeal submitted on | Days counted | Within the window? |
|---|---|---|
| 4 May | 30 | Yes — the last day stands |
| 5 May | 31 | No |

## Closure (hypothetical stays)

| Stays of the account | Closure by the host |
|---|---|
| All completed or cancelled | Permitted |
| One stay confirmed for next month | Not permitted |
| One stay checked in | Not permitted |
